blockingFindings.title: Sidecar metric writes can erase earlier cleanup metrics
blockingFindings.issue: recordFinalizeCleanupPostCommandMetadata() rewrites agent-metrics.json with only the metrics supplied by the current call. finalize-cleanup can call this helper from agent cache hits, normal agent completions, and teardown, so a later call can replace a previously retained post-boundary metric instead of preserving it.
blockingFindings.suggestion: In recordFinalizeCleanupPostCommandMetadata(), when writing the agent-metrics surface, read any existing agent-metrics.json sidecar entries and append the new metrics before calling writeSurface(). Apply the same append behavior to other entry-style sidecars if they can be written more than once.
blockingFindings.rationale: The implementation moves cleanup-time metrics out of the removable worktree, but the retained metadata is not durable if subsequent cleanup metadata writes overwrite it. That creates loss of recorded cleanup metrics after the read-only boundary.

findings.title: Sidecar metric writes can erase earlier cleanup metrics
